## Summary

- What changed?
- Why is it needed?

## Verification

- [ ] `just test` (or `uv run ruff check .`, format, mypy, pytest, Compose)
- [ ] Container build, if Dockerfiles or lockfile changed
- [ ] Docs updated for setup, network, or configuration changes
- [ ] `just copyright -check` passes, if any source file was added

## Privacy and security

- [ ] No secrets, recordings, transcripts, or private hostnames added
- [ ] No weakening of bearer auth, upload limits, retention, or default binding without discussion

## Contributor agreement

- [ ] I have signed the [contributor agreement](https://github.com/VocaHQ/vocagateway/blob/main/CLA.md). On a first pull request the CLA bot comments with the sentence to reply with
